challenge.prompt: Using three.js, build a Minecraft-style voxel world and show it off with a cinematic flythrough. Requirements: a procedurally generated terrain of cube blocks (at least 128x128 columns) using layered noise, with grass-topped hills, snowy mountain peaks, sandy beaches, a lake or sea with semi-transparent water, and trees made of wood and leaf blocks; blocks must have per-face shading so the cube shapes read clearly (draw the block textures procedurally on a canvas, pixel-art style); a sky with a sun, soft distance fog and fluffy block clouds that drift slowly. Use InstancedMesh or merged geometry so it runs smoothly. The camera flies automatically over and between the hills on a smooth path, looking around the landscape. Use the requestAnimationFrame timestamp for animation time. Full-window canvas that handles resizing. Starts automatically, no interaction needed. The animation should show everything important within the first 30 seconds (that is the window we record); it may loop or continue after that.

rubric.es: Hay un terreno amplio hecho de bloques cúbicos (no islas sueltas flotando en el vacío)
Los bloques se distinguen como cubos (caras con sombreado distinto)
Los bloques tienen textura pixelada tipo Minecraft (no colores planos)
Se ven varios tipos de terreno: hierba, montaña con nieve y arena o playa
Hay árboles hechos de bloques (tronco y hojas)
Hay cielo con sol, niebla en la distancia y nubes de bloques
La cámara vuela sobre el paisaje mostrando zonas distintas sin atravesar los bloques
Va fluido (al menos 30 fotogramas por segundo)

challenge.excelente: Un mundo tipo Minecraft creíble: terreno amplio de bloques con texturas pixeladas, varios biomas, agua translúcida, árboles de bloques, cielo con sol, niebla y nubes, y una cámara que sobrevuela sin atravesar nada.
